sources: START_AUDIT.json::sourcePinsSha256; exact CCMG MANIFEST is authoritative for its members

frozenModel.preprocessing: frozen training-only nanmedian, all-missing to zero, nonfinite fill, training mean/std, zero std to one, append nonfinite indicators

environment.firstDiagnosticSetting: single thread: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1, MKL_NUM_THREADS=1, NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1; pinned workflow numpy 2.3.5, scikit-learn 1.8.0, pandas 2.2.3 and Python 3.12; resolved dependency versions captured before fit
environment.originalRecovery: read-only immutable previous Actions logs/artifacts/workflow and saved package logs only; no internet version search or dependency grid
environment.caseA: If original complete package/backend/thread configuration is uniquely identified from immutable evidence before examining numeric mismatch, freeze that exact configuration as CANONICAL_ENVIRONMENT_V2.
environment.caseB: Otherwise freeze the first diagnostic environment as CANONICAL_ENVIRONMENT_V2; old OOF may still fail and must not be relabeled.

beforeFailFastSave: saved implied logit or null reason

canonical.trainTestIdentity: original frozen session temporal folds and pinned IM819/R1 795 test IDs, no cross-fold duplication
canonical.freezeBeforeEconomics: environment hash, model/scaler hashes, train medians, OOF raw scores/probabilities and 1614 route decisions; save CANONICAL_OOF_FREEZE_SHA256

route.low5: test decision score5 < same-fold TRAIN score5 median, strict
route.low10: test decision score10 < same-fold TRAIN score10 median, strict

rankSignalGate.require: each head combined ROC-AUC CI lower >0.5, IM AUC >0.5, R1 AUC >0.5, each relevant fold AUC >=0.5

routeFeasibility.support: each arm Defensive N >=50 and distinct sessions >=12
routeFeasibility.direction: each arm actual >=5 and >=10 rate in Defensive strictly below Default
routeFeasibility.separation: CI upper <0 in all four arm/head comparisons
routeFeasibility.rankDecilesAndQuadrants: descriptive after route freeze, no new threshold

economics.primary: archived R50 funded IM79/R1 32, same Entry/quantity, R34 exact corrected accounting; Defensive CCMG outcome, Default Control outcome; null stays null
economics.coverage: each arm routed known paired >=80%; four arm >=5/>=10 Winner cohorts >=80%
economics.winner: all four cohorts mean net and aggregate exact PnL >= same-arm Control; negative exact delta fails
economics.defensiveValue: each arm actual Defensive subset known coverage >=80% and CCMG-Control aggregate delta >0
economics.lowUpside: each arm evaluator <5 PRR-Control aggregate delta >=0; at least one strict positive
economics.overall: each arm Primary PRR-Control known paired aggregate delta >=0
economics.allEntry: IM819/R1 795 each 100-share standalone; four arm Winner cohort mean/aggregate >=Control, each arm <5 aggregate >=Control and Defensive subset CCMG-Control >0
economics.sessionStability: report share, label rates and PnL deltas; no post-hoc concentration hard threshold

capital.eligibility: source, canonical route, rank signal, route feasibility, Primary, all-entry, Safety all pass
capital.fixed: Selector/Entry/Capital freeze, initial JPY1,000,000, 100-share lot, MAX3, LONG/CASH only
capital.normal: 2 arms x Control/CCMG/PRR x two deterministic passes =12 invocations
capital.normalGateIf24Certified: PRR Final Equity >JPY1M, >=same-arm Control, min cash >=0
capital.stressGateIf24Certified: 24/24, PRR Final Equity >JPY1M and >=same-arm stress Control

independentAudit: separate calculation path for environment/source/fold/preprocessing/model/score/median/route/gates/PnL/fit and replay counts
selection: only if all hard Gates pass, SELECT_DEVELOPMENT_ADAPTIVE; any hard fail NO_SELECTION; productionReady=false regardless
